title: A Metric Mix-Up Left A Plane With 20,400 Pounds
hook: A metric mix-up left a plane carrying only 20,400 pounds.
closing: Units look small until the calculation becomes physical.
question: Where have mixed units caused trouble?

segments.say: Non-metric countries contain 5 percent of the world's population, leaving a small global holdout.
The orbiter dropped to 57 kilometers, showing how one unit mismatch can destroy a mission.
The plane carried 20,400 pounds, less than half the fuel it needed.
